title: ...set up a new home Wi-Fi router
desc: Secure your local network and optimize wireless performance.
todos: Change default admin username and password on router portal immediately.
Update network SSID name to avoid identifying personal or address information.
Enable WPA3 security encryption (or WPA2-Personal minimum).
Set up an isolated Guest Wi-Fi network for IoT and visitor devices.
Enable automatic firmware update checks in router settings.
